comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a connector terminal; record reinstalls two dishwasher filters.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs wire deflection, blade insertion, and coordinated pulling; record slides a lower filter under tabs, aligns coaxial openings, drops in an upper filter, and quarter-turn locks it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one intact terminal removed; record requires the lower filter home and the upper filter seated, bayonet-locked, clear, and still.
comparison.reason: Ordered nested placement and bayonet locking test different abilities from selective extraction.
